summary.text: Frank Moran is a Democratic state representative from the 17th Essex District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is Second Assistant Majority Leader of the House.

paragraphs.text: Frank Moran assumed office on January 2, 2013.
He serves on the House Committee on Rules, the Joint Committee on Rules, and the Special Joint Committee on Initiative Petitions.
